t: When You No Get Anybody Else To Call | Faith Wey No Get Work Don Die | Naija Pidgin Christian Film
d:
God bless you and your family. Mark Holland run lathe for nineteen years. Then dem chain the shop gate, dem carry him truck, and hopeless turn to helpless. Him son wey be fourteen ask the question wey plenty of us dey carry: Why dem dey tell us make we call Jesus when we no get anybody else to call? No be giving up be that?

This story show say to cry out to God no be giving up. Na the first work. Faith dey come first, and faith wey no dey carry hammer don die.

Wetin you for tell Mark for three o'clock for morning? Tell us for comment. Send am give one papa wey need am today for WhatsApp.

Community Covenant app (Scripture wey dem read for you, prayer, and team wey go reply you the same day): https://covenant.crispusmundo.com
The app dey for English for now.
